segments.name: Gas-to-liquids processing technology
segments.description: Converts syngas into fully finished liquid fuels using its STG+ technology, for licensing and deployment at customer plants.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it operates in one operating segment, as the CODM reviews financial information presented on a combined basis for purposes of making operating decisions, allocating resources, and evaluating financial performance.

revenueModel.text: Customers would pay for licensing the STG+ technology and for engineering, technical and operational services under the company's planned capital-lite strategy.
revenueModel.evidence: Such opportunities include licensing technology and providing engineering, technical, and operational services to customers to enable them to build, own, and operate commercial production plants
